Shift register Wena Cran Gop
« A register capable of shifting its binary information in one or

both directions is called a shift register.

« Shift registers are constructed by connecting flip-flops in
cascade, where the output of one flip-flop is connected to the
input of the next flip-flop.

« All flip-flops receive common clock pulses that initiate the shift
from one stage to the next.

« Each remaining flip-flop uses the output of the previous flip-flop
as its input, with the last flip-flop producing the external output
(called the serial output).
